name: Social Snowball
summary: Shopify app for affiliate, referral and influencer programmes with automated payouts, attribution and fraud protection.
best_for: Shopify brands with enough sales to justify $249 or more a month on affiliate, referral and influencer programmes, and that want payouts, attribution and fraud checks in one place
skip_if: you are a small store that cannot spend $249 a month before the first referred sale, your affiliates are mostly outside the US and need non-English pages, or you want a free trial first
honest_knock: It is not cheap: $249 a month plus 3% of affiliate revenue, with no free plan or trial listed. One merchant review from 10 November 2026 says the affiliate side is English only. Fuller creator tools (TikTok Shop, outreach, UGC) sit on the $899 plan. We have not installed it, so the real results are unknown to us.

pricing.entry_price_terms: Snow Day · per month plus 3% of affiliate revenue
pricing.notes: (read 2026-11-18 on the Shopify App Store listing, US dollars, billed every 30 days) Snow Day: $249 a month plus 3% of affiliate revenue; unlimited affiliates, influencer management, post-purchase referrals, automated payouts, fraud and code-leak prevention, tiers and gamification, live chat support. Blizzard: from $899 a month with a custom plan set up after install; adds TikTok Shop, creator search and outreach, social listening, UGC, Instagram DM chat, dedicated customer success manager, no usage charges. No free plan or trial listed. We have not paid for a plan.

schema_offer.description: Snow Day, per month plus 3% of affiliate revenue; Blizzard from $899 per month with no usage charges; no free plan listed. Read on the vendor's own pricing page on 2026-11-18.

compare_with.name: Rewardful
compare_with.why: Rewardful is an affiliate and referral tool for subscription software, not a Shopify app. Compare the monthly cost and whether you need Shopify-specific payouts and creator tools.
